import sys
from pathlib import Path


sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parents[1] / "src"))

from sitegen.frontmatter import parse


def test_parse_extracts_header_key_value_pairs() -> None:
    text = "---\ntitle: Hello World\nauthor: Ada Lovelace\n---\nArticle text\n"

    metadata, _ = parse(text)

    assert metadata == {
        "title": "Hello World",
        "author": "Ada Lovelace",
    }


def test_parse_returns_markdown_after_closing_delimiter_as_body() -> None:
    text = "---\ntitle: A post\n---\n# Heading\n\nBody paragraph.\n"

    _, body = parse(text)

    assert body == "# Heading\n\nBody paragraph.\n"


def test_parse_without_front_matter_returns_empty_metadata_and_full_body() -> None:
    text = "# Heading\n\nOrdinary markdown with no front matter.\n"

    metadata, body = parse(text)

+"""Parsing for the simple front matter used by sitegen Markdown files."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def parse(text: str) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str]:
+    """Return the front-matter metadata and Markdown body from *text*.
+
+    Front matter is recognized only when the document's first line is ``---``.
+    Header entries use ``key: value`` syntax; values may themselves contain
+    colons.  The body is returned byte-for-byte (as a string) following the
+    closing delimiter.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If a front-matter header is unterminated or contains an
+            invalid entry.
+    """
+
+    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
+    if not lines or lines[0].rstrip("\r\n") != "---":
+        return {}, text
+
+    metadata: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for index, line in enumerate(lines[1:], start=1):
+        content = line.rstrip("\r\n")
+        if content == "---":
+            return metadata, "".join(lines[index + 1 :])
+
+        if not content.strip():
+            continue
+        if ":" not in content:
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid front-matter entry on line {index + 1}")
+
+        key, value = content.split(":", 1)
+        key = key.strip()
+        if not key:
+            raise ValueError(f"empty front-matter key on line {index + 1}")
+        if key in metadata:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate front-matter key: {key!r}")
+        metadata[key] = value.strip()
+
+    raise ValueError("front-matter header is missing a closing delimiter")
